title.en: An Act Amending Item Forty-Three, Page One Hundred Eighteen of Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred
title.orig: An Act Amending Item Forty-Three, Page One Hundred Eighteen of Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1746_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item forty-three, page one hundred eighteen of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is amended to read as follows:
"(43) Construction of Central School, Mauban ₱5,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
